## Dune Ranger (CR 2)

A sand-colored figure no thicker than a spear shaft detaches from a stone column, its crystalline spearhead glinting in the dim light.  

**XP** 600  
N Medium fey (extraplanar)  
**Init** +3; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +8  


**Defense**


**AC** 16, touch 16, flat-footed 13 (+3 Dex, +3 Wis)  
**hp** 18 (3d10-3)  
**Fort** +2, **Ref** +6, **Will** +4  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., climb 15 ft.  
**Space** 5 ft.; can compress to move through spaces 1/4 normal size  
**Melee** spear +5 (1d8-2/×3)  
**Ranged** spear +7 (1d8-2/×3)  
**Special Attacks** favored enemy (aberrations +2)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 6, **Dex** 16, **Con** 8, **Int** 14, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 12  
**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +1, **CMD** 14  
**Feats** [Point-Blank Shot](../../rules/feats/point-blank-shot.md), [Weapon Focus (spear)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md)  
*House rules: Point-Blank Shot and Precise Shot are one feat, Point-Blank Shot; in their place: Weapon Focus (spear).*  
**Skills** Climb +4, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +8, Perception +8, Stealth +11, Survival +8  
**Languages** Common, Mimih, Terran  
**SQ** track +1, wild empathy +4, favored terrain (desert +2)  


**Special Abilities**


**Ethereal Step (Sp)** Once per day as a swift action, a dune ranger can become ethereal for 1 round (as ethereal jaunt).  

**Spiderweb Crawl (Ex)** A dune ranger can move along walls and ceilings at half land speed.  

**Compress (Ex)** A dune ranger can move through an area as small as one-eighth its space when squeezing.  

**Environmental Adaptation** A dune ranger gains +4 racial bonus on Fortitude saves against extreme temperatures, -2 penalty on saves against humidity-based effects.  

**Reduced Sustenance** A dune ranger requires food and water as a Tiny creature.  

**Arcane and Psionic Mastery** A dune ranger can cast one 0-level arcane spell and manifest one 0-level psionic power each day as spell-like abilities.  

**Ancient Teachers** A dune ranger gains a +2 racial bonus on Knowledge (dungeoneering) and Knowledge (nature).  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any arid  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or enclave (3–8)  
**Treasure** Standard
